answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the cedar to sunk effort, uses the willow as an corroborating signal, then requires a harbor before any payout.
